data_fields.name: snapshot_period_ms_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 50 (when the client sends no snaps value)

best_idea: Decide per client, per server frame, whether to build and send a snapshot at all (cadence, then a byte-rate gate, then queue not full), and skip rather than queue, so the delta base the server keeps is always one the client has.
decision_why: The cadence, byte-budget and skip-not-queue gates are the reusable shape for a phone client; reject the BSP portal visibility (Frankendom zones are discrete) and the first-come silent entity cap (rank by distance before the cap); Frankendom must never gate kill or hit confirmations, which go on the reliable path.
acceptance: A server test sends a 1200-byte snapshot to a viewer on a 3000 bytes/s budget and asserts the next send is no earlier than about 410 ms later, no send occurs while the reliable queue holds unsent fragments, and with 300 entities in range the 256 kept are the nearest by distance.
